finding.title: Urgent notifications are queued until 07:00
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a queue that holds urgent notifications created at 23:00 until 07:00, because `Notifications of other priorities created during quiet hours are queued and delivered at 07:00.` (S:10) is read next to `Urgent notifications are delivered at any hour.` (S:11), and an urgent alert arrives eight hours late.

e1.text: Notifications of other priorities created during quiet hours are queued and delivered at 07:00.
e1.context:
## 2. Quiet hours
R4. Between 22:00 and 07:00 in the user's time zone, only notifications of priority urgent are delivered.
R5. Notifications of other priorities created during quiet hours are queued and delivered at 07:00.
R6. Urgent notifications are delivered at any hour.

## 3. Limits

e2.text: Urgent notifications are delivered at any hour.
e2.context:
## 2. Quiet hours
R4. Between 22:00 and 07:00 in the user's time zone, only notifications of priority urgent are delivered.
R5. Notifications of other priorities created during quiet hours are queued and delivered at 07:00.

## 3. Limits
R7. A user receives at most 5 notifications per hour over SMS.
